# Payment-Reconciliation-Data-Platform
Built an event-driven payment reconciliation platform using Kafka, Python, and PostgreSQL. It validates, deduplicates, and processes events from application, processor, and billing systems. Identifies missing records and mismatches, and supports audit tracking, batch analytics, and pipeline monitoring.

<img width="1377" height="324" alt="image" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be65decc-ba44-486c-a86b-6e6374b9b4fc" />

**Collect:** Payment events are generated by the application sources.
**Stream:** Events are published to Kafka and consumed by the ingestion service.
**Validate and store:** Python validates, normalizes, and deduplicates events, then stores them in PostgreSQL.
**Reconcile and model:** The pipeline compares records across sources, flags mismatches, and prepares data for analytics.
**Report and monitor:** Reports and dashboards present reconciliation results, Grafana monitors system health and performance.
